responsibility: Defines the public types and interfaces exported by GCC’s DWARF generator to the rest of the compiler and to adjacent debug modules. It declares opaque DIE, attribute, location, CFI, and FDE reference types; the core data structures for call-frame state such as dw_cfi_node, dw_fde_node, cfa_reg, and dw_cfa_location; APIs for CFA/location construction and CFI emission; debugging and demangling helpers; array and fixed-point description structures; and the DWARF-internal accessors and constructors that other modules, especially dwarf2ctf.cc and BTF code, use to inspect GCC-generated DIEs and attributes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the exported DWARF types, CFI/location structures, and accessor/constructor APIs from dwarf2out.cc, including the DIE-inspection entry points consumed by dwarf2ctf.h/cc; unlike the .cc file, it is the interface and type-definition surface, not the DWARF emitter implementation.
